hints.title: Target Balance Difference
hints.text: The difference between the candy sizes exchanged must equal half of the total weight difference between Alice and Bob.

hints.title: Algebraic Relation Formulation
hints.text: Let delta equal half of (sumB - sumA). For each candy size x of Alice, Bob must provide exactly x plus delta.

hints.title: Collection Membership Lookup
hints.text: Store Bob candy values in a lookup collection. Iterate through Alice candies and return [x, x + delta] on the first match.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Lookup set membership test per Alice element.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every pair (x, y) takes O(A * B) quadratic comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set of Bob elements requires O(B) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Express total exchange equality algebraically and use set lookup.
